name: mirage
text: Yes, partly my doing: I restarted the engine at 00:38, 01:22 and again just now (01:39) to load the logging, then the SharpAPI and Novig-stream fixes, and every restart starts a cold scan (about 10 minutes) instead of the usual 45-second refresh. This restart is the last one for these fixes, so it should settle into short scans once this first pass finishes. A settings change on your phone also restarts a scan when it changes what is read.
